verdicts.reason: Neither candidate is a real resize. Both drop the original single-row strip (logo, headline, Shop button) unchanged into the middle of a tall portrait canvas, so about 90% of the frame is empty dark space. The headline stays small instead of becoming the dominant element, and nothing is rearranged into a top-to-bottom reading order. A is marginally better because its logo margin (~14px) nearly matches the button's right margin (~11px). B's logo sits ~27px in against an ~11px right margin, making the row visibly off-balance.
